name: Higashi no Eden Movie II: Paradise Lost
name_english: Eden of the East Movie II: Paradise Lost
name_romanji: Eden of the East Movie II: Paradise Lost
original_title: 東のエデン 劇場版II Paradise Lost
description: Accused of terrorism and feeling the heat, Saki's high-tech crew is in the crosshairs. Meanwhile, the shroud of mystery covering Takizawa is lifted as he and his fellow Selecao make their final moves. Every game must come to an end. For those playing Mr. Outside's twisted game of conspiracy thrills, the end comes now.
